description: Get a Stripe Checkout URL so the user can add or update their credit card. REQUIRED after registration and whenever a 402 error occurs. The user must open the returned URL in their browser to add/update their card. Billing is pay-per-successful-request: no monthly fee, no minimums. You are only charged for successful API responses (2xx). Prices vary per API (see get_api_info). API calls are blocked until a valid credit card is on file.
name: get_payment_url
